description: An on-screen sostenuto pedal for the Eagan Matrix instrument, with a slider that follows a real pedal assigned to the same function; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets the sostenuto amount on the instrument; click anywhere along it to jump there, or scroll it; with the pointer over it HOME and END go to the ends, the arrow keys step, and 0 to 9 jump by tenths
Takes the sostenuto to zero in one click
Takes the sostenuto to its maximum in one click
Sets how far the voltage at the input moves the sostenuto, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched

inputs.text: Moves the sostenuto away from the slider position, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
pedal assignments made in CHEM Jack have no effect here; this module is always sostenuto

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
